cohort: 10 women who had been married for 2 years but had not consummated their marriage due to vaginismus.
finding: The study suggests that spinal anesthesia facilitated sexual intercourse may be a viable treatment option for vaginismus, as it led to successful intercourse and improvements in sexual function, penetration cognition, and pain in most participants.
mod_finding: Out of the 5 couples who became pregnant, 3 delivered vaginally.
